audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar Transjordan settlement negotiation text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Reuben/Gad livestock request, Moses' fear of communal discouragement, Kadesh memory, armed-vanguard pledge, legal conditions, family settlements, east-Jordan allocation, half-Manasseh expansion, and place renaming.

verses.restored: Sons of Reuben and sons of Gad had very great abundance of livestock. They saw land of Jazer and land of Gilead, and look, the place was a place for livestock.

familiar.text: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

modern.text: Now the Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, surveyed the lands of Jazer and Gilead, and they saw that the region was suitable for livestock.

original.text: וּמִקְנֶ֣ה רַ֗ב הָיָ֞ה לִבְנֵ֧י רְאוּבֵ֛ן וְלִבְנֵי גָ֖ד עָצ֣וּם מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּרְא֞וּ אֶת אֶ֤רֶץ יַעְזֵר֙ וְאֶת אֶ֣רֶץ גִּלְעָ֔ד וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַמָּק֖וֹם מְק֥וֹם מִקְנֶֽה

verses.restored: Sons of Gad and sons of Reuben came and spoke to Moses and Eleazar the priest and leaders of congregation, saying,

familiar.text: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

modern.text: So the Gadites and Reubenites came to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the congregation, and said,

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ בְנֵֽי גָ֖ד וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶל אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon—

familiar.text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

modern.text: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

original.text: עֲטָר֤וֹת וְדִיבֹן֙ וְיַעְזֵ֣ר וְנִמְרָ֔ה וְחֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה וּשְׂבָ֥ם וּנְב֖וֹ וּבְעֹֽן

verses.restored: the land that YHWH struck before congregation of Israel—is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock.

familiar.text: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

modern.text: which the LORD conquered before the congregation of Israel, are suitable for livestock—and your servants have livestock.”

original.text: הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִפְנֵי֙ עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֥רֶץ מִקְנֶ֖ה הִ֑וא וְלַֽעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ מִקְנֶֽה

verses.restored: They said, If we have found favor in your eyes, let this land be given to your servants as possession; do not make us cross Jordan.

familiar.text: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.

modern.text: “If we have found favor in your sight,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”

original.text: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אִם מָצָ֤אנוּ חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ יֻתַּ֞ן אֶת הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לַעֲבָדֶ֖יךָ לַאֲחֻזָּ֑ה אַל תַּעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּֽן

verses.restored: Moses said to sons of Gad and sons of Reuben, Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

familiar.text: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

modern.text: But Moses asked the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִבְנֵי גָ֖ד וְלִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן הַאַֽחֵיכֶ֗ם יָבֹ֨אוּ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְאַתֶּ֖ם תֵּ֥שְׁבוּ פֹֽה

verses.restored: Why do you turn aside heart of children of Israel from crossing into land that YHWH has given them?

familiar.text: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?

modern.text: Why are you discouraging the Israelites from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them?

original.text: וְלָ֣מָּה תנואון אֶת לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵֽעֲבֹר֙ אֶל הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Thus your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see land.

familiar.text: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.

modern.text: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land.

original.text: כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּשָׁלְחִ֥י אֹתָ֛ם מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: They went up to wadi of Eshcol and saw land, and turned aside heart of children of Israel so they would not enter land YHWH had given them.

familiar.text: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

modern.text: For when your fathers went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land that the LORD had given them.

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲל֞וּ עַד נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֗וֹל וַיִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיָּנִ֕יאוּ אֶת לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְבִלְתִּי בֹא֙ אֶל הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Anger of YHWH burned on that day, and he swore, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD’s anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

modern.text: So the anger of the LORD was kindled that day, and He swore an oath, saying,

original.text: וַיִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Surely none of men who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see ground I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, for they did not follow fully after me,

familiar.text: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

modern.text: ‘Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years of age or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—

original.text: אִם יִרְא֨וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים הָעֹלִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה אֵ֚ת הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י לֹא מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרָֽי

verses.restored: except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they followed fully after YHWH.

familiar.text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.

modern.text: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun—because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly.’

original.text: בִּלְתִּ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה֙ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נ֑וּן כִּ֥י מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Anger of YHWH burned against Israel, and he made them wander in wilderness forty years, until all generation doing evil in eyes of YHWH came to an end.

familiar.text: And the LORD’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.

modern.text: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation who had done evil in His sight was gone.

original.text: וַיִּֽחַר אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְנִעֵם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה עַד תֹּם֙ כָּל הַדּ֔וֹר הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: And look, you have risen in place of your fathers, a brood of sinful men, to add still more to burning anger of YHWH against Israel.

familiar.text: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

modern.text: Now behold, you, a brood of sinners, have risen up in place of your fathers to further stoke the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.

original.text: וְהִנֵּ֣ה קַמְתֶּ֗ם תַּ֚חַת אֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תַּרְבּ֖וּת אֲנָשִׁ֣ים חַטָּאִ֑ים לִסְפּ֣וֹת ע֗וֹד עַ֛ל חֲר֥וֹן אַף יְהוָ֖ה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: If you turn back from after him, he will again leave them in wilderness, and you will destroy all this people.

familiar.text: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

modern.text: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.”

original.text: כִּ֤י תְשׁוּבֻן֙ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֔יו וְיָסַ֣ף ע֔וֹד לְהַנִּיח֖וֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְשִֽׁחַתֶּ֖ם לְכָל הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: They came near to him and said, Sheepfolds we will build here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.

familiar.text: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

modern.text: Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.

original.text: וַיִּגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ וַ֣יֹּאמְר֔וּ גִּדְרֹ֥ת צֹ֛אן נִבְנֶ֥ה לְמִקְנֵ֖נוּ פֹּ֑ה וְעָרִ֖ים לְטַפֵּֽנוּ

verses.restored: But we ourselves will equip ourselves, hastening before children of Israel until we bring them to their place; our little ones shall dwell in fortified cities because of inhabitants of land.

familiar.text: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

modern.text: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them into their place. Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land.

original.text: וַאֲנַ֜חְנוּ נֵחָלֵ֣ץ חֻשִׁ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִם הֲבִֽיאֹנֻ֖ם אֶל מְקוֹמָ֑ם וְיָשַׁ֤ב טַפֵּ֨נוּ֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הַמִּבְצָ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: We will not return to our houses until each one of children of Israel has inherited his inheritance.

familiar.text: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

modern.text: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has taken possession of his inheritance.

original.text: לֹ֥א נָשׁ֖וּב אֶל בָּתֵּ֑ינוּ עַ֗ד הִתְנַחֵל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: For we will not inherit with them across Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on east side of Jordan.

familiar.text: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

modern.text: Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”

original.text: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נִנְחַל֙ אִתָּ֔ם מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וָהָ֑לְאָה כִּ֣י בָ֤אָה נַחֲלָתֵ֨נוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ מֵעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה

verses.restored: Moses said to them, If you do this thing, if you equip yourselves before YHWH for war,

familiar.text: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,

modern.text: Moses replied, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִֽם תַּעֲשׂ֖וּן אֶת הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה אִם תֵּחָֽלְצ֛וּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָֽה

verses.restored: and every equipped one among you crosses Jordan before YHWH until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

familiar.text: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

modern.text: and if every one of your armed men crosses the Jordan before the LORD, until He has driven His enemies out before Him,

original.text: וְעָבַ֨ר לָכֶ֧ם כָּל חָל֛וּץ אֶת הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַ֧ד הוֹרִישׁ֛וֹ אֶת אֹיְבָ֖יו מִפָּנָֽיו

verses.restored: and land is subdued before YHWH, afterward you shall return and be free from obligation before YHWH and Israel; and this land shall be your possession before YHWH.

familiar.text: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

modern.text: then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will belong to you as a possession before the LORD.

original.text: וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאַחַ֣ר תָּשֻׁ֔בוּ וִהְיִיתֶ֧ם נְקִיִּ֛ים מֵיְהוָ֖ה וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠הָיְתָה הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֥את לָכֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: But if you do not do so, look, you have sinned/misaligned against YHWH; know your sin/misalignment will find you.

familiar.text: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.

modern.text: But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD—and be assured that your sin will find you out.

original.text: וְאִם לֹ֤א תַעֲשׂוּן֙ כֵּ֔ן הִנֵּ֥ה חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַיהוָ֑ה וּדְעוּ֙ חַטַּאתְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּמְצָ֖א אֶתְכֶֽם

verses.restored: Build for yourselves cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, and what has gone out from your mouth, do.

familiar.text: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

modern.text: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”

original.text: בְּנֽוּ לָכֶ֤ם עָרִים֙ לְטַפְּכֶ֔ם וּגְדֵרֹ֖ת לְצֹנַאֲכֶ֑ם וְהַיֹּצֵ֥א מִפִּיכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: Sons of Gad and sons of Reuben said to Moses, saying, Your servants will do as my lord commands.

familiar.text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

modern.text: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do just as our lord commands.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בְּנֵי גָד֙ וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ יַעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽה

verses.restored: Our little ones, our wives, our livestock, and all our beasts shall be there in cities of Gilead,

familiar.text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

modern.text: Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead.

original.text: טַפֵּ֣נוּ נָשֵׁ֔ינוּ מִקְנֵ֖נוּ וְכָל בְּהֶמְתֵּ֑נוּ יִֽהְיוּ שָׁ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֥י הַגִּלְעָֽד

verses.restored: but your servants will cross over, everyone equipped for host, before YHWH to war, as my lord speaks.

familiar.text: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.

modern.text: But your servants are equipped for war, and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD, just as our lord says.”

original.text: וַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ יַֽעַבְר֜וּ כָּל חֲל֥וּץ צָבָ֛א לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י דֹּבֵֽר

verses.restored: Moses commanded concerning them Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and heads of fathers' houses of tribes of children of Israel.

familiar.text: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

modern.text: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the family leaders of the tribes of Israel.

original.text: וַיְצַ֤ו לָהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֑וּן וְאֶת רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Moses said to them, If sons of Gad and sons of Reuben cross Jordan with you, everyone equipped for war before YHWH, and land is subdued before you, then you shall give them land of Gilead as possession.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

modern.text: And Moses said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, with every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אִם יַעַבְר֣וּ בְנֵי גָ֣ד וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵ֣ן אִ֠תְּכֶם אֶֽת הַיַּרְדֵּ֞ן כָּל חָל֤וּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם לָהֶ֛ם אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֖ד לַאֲחֻזָּֽה

verses.restored: But if they do not cross equipped with you, then they shall receive possessions in your midst in land of Canaan.

familiar.text: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

modern.text: But if they do not arm themselves and go across with you, then they must accept their possession among you in the land of Canaan.”

original.text: וְאִם לֹ֧א יַֽעַבְר֛וּ חֲלוּצִ֖ים אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְנֹֽאחֲז֥וּ בְתֹכְכֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן

verses.restored: Sons of Gad and sons of Reuben answered, saying, What YHWH has spoken to your servants, so we will do.

familiar.text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

modern.text: The Gadites and Reubenites replied, “As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲנ֧וּ בְנֵי גָ֛ד וּבְנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה

verses.restored: We will cross equipped before YHWH into land of Canaan, but possession of our inheritance shall be with us across Jordan.

familiar.text: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.

modern.text: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD, that we may have our inheritance on this side of the Jordan.”

original.text: נַ֣חְנוּ נַעֲבֹ֧ר חֲלוּצִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְאִתָּ֨נוּ֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָתֵ֔נוּ מֵעֵ֖בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן

verses.restored: Moses gave to sons of Gad and sons of Reuben and half tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph kingdom of Sihon king of Amorite and kingdom of Og king of Bashan, land with its cities in borders, cities of land around.

familiar.text: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

modern.text: So Moses gave to the Gadites, to the Reubenites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them.

translation_notes: The request begins from livestock abundance and ecological suitability, not simple refusal of covenant responsibility.
Moses initially hears the request through the trauma of Numbers 13-14 and fears another collapse of communal courage.
The tribes negotiate a conditional settlement: they will assist the larger community before returning to their east-Jordan homes.
Women and children remain in fortified settlements while men fight; their vulnerability and lack of direct voice should remain visible.
The final verses describe conquest, dispossession, rebuilding, and renaming. These are ancient territorial claims and must not authorize modern colonization or erasure of prior inhabitants.
The phrase 'your sin will find you' refers in context to breaking a public communal commitment, not a universal tool for threatening people.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 32 to glorify militarized masculinity, abandon family caregivers, threaten people with hidden punishment, or sanctify modern settlement and dispossession. Its constructive thread is accountable negotiation: resources, obligations, risks, and promises are made explicit before land is allocated.
